types.label: Terminal bell
types.description: The tone a terminal session rings. The Terminal's own bell setting still picks sound, flash or off.

types.label: Claude link: axHub unreachable
types.description: The console's calls to axHub stopped getting through (Claude link disconnect line). Off by default: the systems check banner already shows a dead hub.

types.label: Claude link: error
types.description: An error line on the Claude link: a refused token on /mcp or axHub, a crashed headless run, a failed MCP call. Off by default.
